comment: CC0 third-party asset packs. The asset-fetch workflow downloads each pack on a CI runner (the dev sandbox has no outbound internet), extracts only the GLB models, writes a LICENSE.txt beside them, and commits the result to game/assets/thirdparty/<name>/. Game code must ALWAYS keep a procedural fallback: assets are dressing, never a dependency (docs/11 §6).

packs.name: nature-kit
packs.why: bare trees, rocks, fence pieces, stone-wall segments for New England fields (Battle Road cover set will build on these)

packs.name: pirate-kit
packs.why: barrels, crates, carts, dock pieces — colonial harbor and camp props (Boston wharves, King Street dressing)
